title: LSASS credential dumping on WORKSTATION-22
verdict_rationale: Process accessed LSASS memory consistent with credential dumping (T1003.001). Bounded blast radius to the logged-on account and rotated its credentials before the adversary reused them.
summary_text: A non-system process opened LSASS on WORKSTATION-22 and read its memory — classic OS credential dumping (T1003.001). The logged-on account corp\a.okafor was the exposed credential. Established that the account had not yet been reused elsewhere, then isolated the host and force-reset the account plus its active sessions. No lateral movement observed; contained before pivot.
